mapper.sql: id, original_filename, file_size, file_sha256, status, total_rows, success_rows, failed_rows, hdfs_path, error_report_path, failure_stage, retry_count, staging_path, error_message, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM house_import_task WHERE successful_sha256 = #{fileSha256} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE house_import_task SET status = #{nextStatus}, retry_count = retry_count + CASE WHEN #{incrementRetry} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, failure_stage = CASE WHEN #{nextStatus} = 'RETRYING' THEN failure_stage ELSE NULL END, error_message = CASE WHEN #{nextStatus} = 'RETRYING' THEN NULL ELSE error_message END WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}

UPDATE house_import_task SET total_rows = #{totalRows}, success_rows = #{successRows}, failed_rows = #{failedRows}, hdfs_path = COALESCE(#{hdfsPath}, hdfs_path), error_report_path = COALESCE(#{errorReportPath}, error_report_path), staging_path = COALESCE(#{stagingPath}, staging_path) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE house_import_task SET status = 'SUCCESS', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, error_message = NULL, failure_stage = NULL, staging_path = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}

UPDATE house_import_task SET status = 'FAILED', failure_stage = #{failureStage}, total_rows = #{totalRows}, success_rows = #{successRows}, failed_rows = #{failedRows}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, error_report_path = COALESCE(#{errorReportPath}, error_report_path), finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
